title: Correction increment for the Capability Genesis Loop after external review
problem: Observation: an external review reproduced four defects at PR #129 head 00765bc with isolated synthetic dependencies: a part id accepted a different callable; three timeouts produced ready_for_ratification; killing a case left its shadow bound; 'connection refused' was classified as a doctrinal refusal. The review also named two gaps: candidates were supplied by the caller with no discovery step, and the ladder was rigid while accepting unsupported 'searched_none' declarations. Proposal: correct all six inside the existing draft, under existing developmental authority, linked to ADR-GENESIS-001.
baseline: PR #129 head 00765bc: parts board with metadata-only identity; genesis loop counting every shadow attempt as a sample; close() leaving shadows bound; evolution.failure_analysis.classify matching error strings; propose() requiring pre-registered parts and accepting bare 'searched_none'.

alternatives.name: Keep metadata identity, add a warning when a callable changes
alternatives.description: Log a mismatch instead of binding identity to the artifact.
disadvantages: the dossier would still describe one thing and bind another
a warning is not a refusal
alternatives.revival_evidence: none; the review's requirement is a bound identity

alternatives.name: Hash source text with inspect.getsource only
disadvantages: closures with the same source but different captured values collide (rule_proposer('A') vs rule_proposer('B'))
fails for callables without retrievable source
alternatives.revival_evidence: a deployment where every part is a module-level function with no closure state

alternatives.name: Learned diagnosis (model classifies responsibility)
alternatives.description: Use a local model to attribute deficits.
disadvantages: model output is not evidence (verifier tiers 6-7)
a model judging whether to replace a model
alternatives.revival_evidence: a frozen evaluation where learned attribution beats the deterministic rules on held-out cycles with a strong verifier

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The loop would keep promoting on attempts, keep a killed case's shadow consuming budget, misread transport errors as constitutional refusals, and let a bare declaration unlock new architecture.

roles.position: The corrections move the loop toward the founder's effect: capability actually forms (discovery, commissioning) and only proven capability is retained. 'Searched_none' now means a recorded search; the ladder stays a prior with documented exceptions, matching FOUNDER_EFFECT_COMPILER.md.
material_concerns: Market ambition must stay explicit and separate from internal governance; docs/EXTERNAL_WEDGE_OPTIONS.md carries it

roles.position: Identity is bound at registration by an implementation digest included in part_id; stop reuses the suspend pattern as a ledgered stop record applied without a grant; failures are typed at the raising site; discovery sources are a small protocol with four defaults; missions are a seam (lineage on the deficit, pause/resume records, unblock on genome) rather than a third mission plane next to #160/#137.
material_concerns: The fingerprint covers code and public state at registration, not external weights; model_digest is declared, not computed
Hydration of specs and bindings is now one ordered pass so stops replay in sequence

roles.position: Nineteen guards were removed one at a time; each removal failed at least one test after four tests were added. One mutant survived and was equivalent (successes >= min is implied by distinct success cycles >= min); the dead clause was removed rather than tested around.
material_concerns: A proposer can still record a false override or exception; both are attributed and need evidence refs, which the ratifier sees
Diagnosis rules can misattribute novel patterns; they return 'unknown' and block replacement rather than guessing

roles.position: Stopping is now effective and free; re-registering changed code after restart fails loudly instead of silently taking over an identity; discovery reads a local catalog file and an optional search object, no network by default.
material_concerns: Detector thresholds and diagnosis rules are code defaults, not ratified configuration

roles.position: All evidence remains sandbox tier. Victim protection improved: a working Guardian cannot be replaced on the strength of its vetoes; failures never count as successes; a killed case cannot keep executing. The two-mission test measures reuse by search depth and registrations, not time or cost.
material_concerns: No live case; no external verification; verify_outcome is internal re-observation and says so

evidence.claim: Each reproduced defect is now refused and regression-tested

evidence.finding: 19 guards removed one at a time; each fails a test; one equivalent mutant removed as dead code
666 passed, 4 skipped, 2 failed; the 2 fail identically on main (shallow clone); main baseline 624 passed

evidence.claim: Reuse lowers effort at equal reliability
evidence.finding: ladder depth 3 -> 0, new registrations 1 -> 0, trial successes 3/3 both; time and cost not measured

counterevidence.claim: The loop creates and retains better capabilities in reality

counterevidence.finding: it is a stable approximation over code and public state at registration; not weights, not later mutation

pass_1.intended_outcome: Only proven, identity-bound capability is retained; stopping is effective; failures are typed; candidates are discovered with evidence; the ladder stays a prior.

advantages.amplified_value: Dossiers, genomes and bindings now name one executable thing; provenance becomes auditable across restarts.
Retention claims become falsifiable: the dossier states what was restored and what was not measured.
Every 'we searched' is a record a later contributor can inspect; the anti-literalization gate has teeth.
Working safeguards are protected from being optimized away; replacement effort goes where the fault is.

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Documented limits; model_digest declared separately; refusal on mismatch rather than silent acceptance.
Deterministic, recorded, labelled a prior; 'unknown' blocks replacement; human override with evidence.

disadvantages.statement: More records and states per case
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Each record is the evidence the review asked for; states are the minimum for restart safety.

disadvantages.statement: Reuse metric omits time and cost
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Named in the doc; the first live case adds wall-clock and resource-governor cost.

comparisons.do_nothing: Defects stay live; nothing compounds safely.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Fix only the four reproduced defects without discovery or diagnosis. Rejected: the review's two larger gaps are what make formation real.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Learned diagnosis and learned candidate ranking. Rejected now: model output is not evidence; revival on a frozen evaluation win.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: This increment in the same draft PR; revert restores 00765bc.

rejected_alternatives.name: Learned diagnosis
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: frozen eval win with strong verifier

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the corrected loop: equivalent and surviving mutants, false overrides, false exceptions, fingerprint evasion by mutating state after registration, forged stop records, and the temptation to call internal re-observation 'verification'.

new_weaknesses.statement: An override or exception with any evidence string passes
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Attributed and visible in the dossier; follow-up may require evidence refs to resolve to ledger records or URLs.

new_weaknesses.statement: Fingerprint ignores state mutated after registration
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Documented; parts are expected to be pure callables; a later increment may re-fingerprint at bind time.

new_weaknesses.statement: Three records (diagnosis, discovery, candidates) before a trial
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Each answers one review question; README table lists them in order.

pass_2.final_design: As implemented at this increment: artifact-bound PartSpec identity; grant-free shadow stop; typed failures; diagnosis gate; discovery sources with recorded leads; evidence-bearing ladder with documented exceptions; success- and target-based readiness; strong-verifier rule for non-mechanical targets; mission pause/resume seam; internal outcome verification; measured reuse.

residual_risks.mitigation: EXPERIMENT decision; labels in docs and dossier scope statement
residual_risks.review_trigger: any completion claim without a live case

residual_risks.risk: Divergence from the goal records in open PR #160
residual_risks.mitigation: seam uses goal_id lineage and genome registration, the two points #160 names
residual_risks.review_trigger: #160 or a mission engine lands on main

dissent.handling: Preserved; does not block a draft experiment.

entries.position: Override and exception evidence is free text
entries.rationale: Any non-empty string satisfies the requirement
entries.evidence_threshold: Evidence refs must resolve to ledger records, discovery leads or URLs before an exception admits new_architecture

migration_plan: Additive within PR #129: PartSpec gains optional artifact_digest/model_digest (unbound specs are bound at registration, so existing callers keep working); one new record type (egregore.shadow_stopped); genesis gains diagnose/discover/commission/verify stages. Merge follows founder review; live use needs Gate grants.

steps: ledgers keep the new records as history; old code ignores unknown record types

kill_criteria: A part with different code is ever resolved under an existing part_id
A case reaches ready_for_ratification with zero successful evaluations
A terminal case's shadow produces a shadow_result after the stop record
A transport error is ever classified as doctrinal_refusal
review_trigger: First live case, or founder review of PR #129
